_note: Remote-backend (proxy) example for Soul-AILab/SoulX-Singer. This frontend installs ONLY pyharp + gradio + gradio_client and forwards inference to the live Space's /synthesis_function via gradio_client. The positional 'args' below mirror the EXACT signature of synthesis_function in the Space's webui.py (as bound by synthesis_btn.click): prompt_audio, target_audio, prompt_metadata, target_metadata, control, auto_shift, pitch_shift, seed, prompt_lyric_lang, target_lyric_lang, prompt_vocal_sep, target_vocal_sep. The two metadata File args are OPTIONAL -- passing null makes the backend auto-run transcription -- so they are hidden here (const null) instead of shown to users. Point framework.remote.space at your own duplicate for API stability / your own ZeroGPU quota.

model.name: SoulX-Singer
model.description: Zero-shot singing voice synthesis: sing a target melody in a reference voice. This is a thin HARP frontend that proxies to the upstream SoulX-Singer Gradio Space over gradio_client, so none of its heavy (and pyharp-conflicting) dependencies are installed here.
model.author: Soul-AILab

inputs.name: prompt_audio
inputs.label: Reference voice
inputs.info: A clip of the target singer's voice (the timbre to sing with), max 30s.

inputs.name: target_audio
inputs.label: Target melody
inputs.info: The song/melody to reproduce in the reference voice, max 60s.

inputs.name: control
inputs.label: Control type
inputs.info: How SoulX follows the target: 'melody' tracks the sung pitch; 'score' follows note quantization.

inputs.name: auto_shift
inputs.label: Auto pitch shift
inputs.info: Let the model choose the pitch shift automatically.

inputs.name: pitch_shift
inputs.label: Manual pitch shift (semitones)
inputs.info: Used when auto pitch shift is off (-36 to 36).

inputs.name: prompt_vocal_sep
inputs.label: Separate vocals from reference
inputs.info: Run vocal separation on the reference clip first.

inputs.name: target_vocal_sep
inputs.label: Separate vocals from target
inputs.info: Run vocal separation on the target melody first.

outputs.name: generated
outputs.label: Generated singing
outputs.info: The target melody sung in the reference voice.
